inferences: The current candidate profile samples about 4.24 s in the native selection guard; about 3.56 s is called during content updates and 0.674 s from the cleanup timer.
React render entry and context propagation are prominent sampled stacks. Inclusive totals overlap and must not be added.
This is one pair with profiler overhead. It does not establish a speed difference, explain the scripted return-bottom failure, or prove every frame regression has the same cause.
A 300 ms stream-quiet compaction experiment is tested separately. The 140 ms visual fade and synchronous selection checks remain unchanged.

observations: rangeCount returns cheaply when a document-cached range exists; otherwise it also calls UpdateStyleAndLayout.
getRangeAt and alternate anchor/focus getters route through rangeCount. Caching the Selection object alone does not remove the no-range layout path.
nativeSelectionSource.retrieval: Exact tag fetched directly over HTTPS and decoded from Gitiles TEXT. Historical search results were not used.

limits: Linux Chromium; no M2 Air, battery, field INP, memory leak, or subjective smoothness claim.
No permanent instrumentation was added to production code.
